# **CubiKonce 2027**
​
## **Español**
​
¡Se celebra en Concepción la onceava edición de la competición **"CubiKonce"**, en esta ocasión llamada **"CubiKonce 2027"**! 
​
✨ **¡Los esperamos con ansias en esta competición!**
🍀 **¡Buena suerte, amigos cuberos!**
​
No te pierdas la oportunidad de ser parte de esta emocionante competición. **¡Prepárate para desafiar tus habilidades cuberas y disfrutar de un día lleno de diversión!**
​
**¡Nos vemos en Concepción!**

---
​
## **English**
​
The eleventh edition of the **'CubiKonce'** competition is taking place in Concepción, this time named **'CubiKonce 2027.'**! 
​
✨ **We eagerly await your participation in this competition.**  
🍀 **Good luck, cube enthusiast friends!**
​
Don't miss the opportunity to be part of this thrilling competition. **Get ready to challenge your cubing skills and enjoy a day filled with fun!**
​
**See you in Concepción!**

items.name: Illinois Quiet Championship 2027
items.information:
This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org).
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbVZoIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1b3d9004e1f9dfdbe319a8f4bd8117aa0a47de6b/image.png)

This competition does **not** include normal 3x3 and is not recommended for first time competitors. Please check out [Illinois Championship 2027](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IllinoisChampionship2027), which will be more friendly towards beginners.

items.name: Super Duper San Diego 2027

venue.name: UC San Diego
venue.address: Price Center, UCSD, 9500 Gilman Dr, La Jolla, CA 92093

items.information:
UCSD students can register for free! Put "UCSD Student" in your registration comment and email ucsdcubing@gmail.com with your student ID. 

This competition is organized by Rubik's Cube Club @ UC San Diego, in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/).
